internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The root qdr is about setting a thing to its exact measure or bound. Seen from the agent's side it is the power to fix and control that measure (God is qadir, 'able over everything'); seen from the thing's side it is the measure, term, decree, or worth that has been fixed (water sent down bi-qadar, 'in measure'; a decreed span; the due worth of God). The same verb can mean 'have power over', 'ration/straiten provision', 'appraise the worth of', or 'decree' depending on its object - which is why measure and power are two views of one act, not two unrelated words. One concrete item (cauldrons, 34:13) is just a homonym and stands outside this.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: qdr does NOT entail: (1) creation/origination - it follows khalq as the proportioning step (khalaqahu faqaddarahu 80:19; khalaqnahu bi-qadar 54:49; 25:2); (2) brute strength/might - listed apart from qawiyy/aziz (22:74; azizin muqtadir 54:42); (3) abundance/increase - in provision it is the RESTRICTIVE measure, antonym of basata (13:26), never 'give much'; (4) actualization - capacity may be unexercised (qadir ala an yunazzila...wa-lakin 6:37; 17:99); (5) knowledge/will/dominion - held lexically apart from alim, yashau, mulk (16:70, 5:17, 57:2); (6) benevolence - the measure can be adverse (straitened provision as trial 89:16; decreed death 56:60; malicious human calculation 74:19); (7) arbitrariness - the measure is malum/maqdur, exact (15:21, 33:38, 65:3). The power is never unbounded: it is always power OVER a named object (ala-complement), even ala kulli shayin qadir.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 34:13 quduwrK (the fixed cauldrons made for Solomon) is a concrete manufactured artifact with no Quran-internal tie to measure, decree, or power; any 'vessel of a capacity' bridge is a forbidden etymological prior, so it is a lexicalized nominal outside the field.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: Two rival accounts, both rejected. (a) PURE-POWER (qudra) MONISM: take 'ability/power' as the single core (justified by ~45 qadir + 14 qadir-participle + 4 muqtadir + ability-verbs) and derive qadar/taqdir/miqdar as products of divine power; it handles the divine-predicate majority elegantly but cannot absorb miqdaruhu alfa sanah (32:5, a duration), qaddir fi l-sard (34:11, craft proportioning), fakkara wa-qaddara (74:18, cognitive calculation), or haqqa qadrihi (6:91, valuation). (b) SYNCHRONIC HOMONYMY SPLIT (qdr1 power / qdr2 measure / qdr3 cauldron): morphology sorts fairly cleanly, but the form-I verb refuses the split - in the SAME 'qadara ala (rizq)' frame and the yabsut/yaqdir antithesis the power-form verb MEANS 'measure-out/straiten', a live lexeme astride both poles. The homonymy account survives only for the dead item qudur (34:13) and, weakly, as a caution on laylat al-qadr. Neither pole reduces to the other from the text, so the honest result is a bridged two-pole field, not a monism and not full homonymy fragmentation.

internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses independently converged on a single measure/bound-fixing nucleus that internally welds the power and measure poles, broad and adversarially robust across ~128 of 132 tokens and all six forms, with clean negative boundaries and sharp Quran-internal contrasts (vs basata, khalaqa, qawiyy, alim, mulk). The internal weld is textual, not merely conceptual: (i) yabsutu l-rizqa...wa-yaqdir (13:26 + 8 parallels) makes the power-form verb mean 'straiten the measure'; (ii) faqadarna fa-nima l-qadirun (77:23) glosses a power-pole participle with the measure-verb; (iii) the same qadara-ala frame yields power (90:5), straiten (89:16), and esteem (22:74). STRONG/UNIVERSAL is nonetheless barred by the contract's explicit caps: a resistant lexicalized nominal sub-class exists (quduwr 34:13, unbridged) and a semi-lexicalized idiom underdetermined by the nucleus (laylat al-qadr 97:1-3), and the unifying gloss risks over-breadth while the power-to-measure bridge is internally suggested rather than exhaustively demonstrated. This caps strength at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE. UNRESOLVED would be too severe a downgrade: the poles ARE demonstrably bridged within the live form-I verb and the dominant senses are clean, so this is multiple related classes bridged, not unbridged homonymy across the productive family.
